decisions.reason: The IMU module is a core building block in the firm's modular system and fits the announced move to newer connectors, so the design and firmware investment and its catalogue presence argue for keeping it.

Its dedicated product page signals visible public commitment, and the industrial AC voltage input supports the energy-management direction, so any weak early sales would be read as a temporary ramp-up.
The solid state relay is a low-cost addition close to the established offer that complements the automation and control line, so there is little reason to withdraw it after one year.

The server room kit only bundles existing modules and is less central to the charging and standalone-controller direction, but it costs little to keep and is still early in its life, so management keeps it.
